title: reconcile-stream-token-wrap-and-delimiter-collision-handling
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Intermittent production incidents showed that when clients send rapid small SSE chunks from heterogeneous networks we sometimes emit adjacent delimiter tokens that collide with partial JSON fragments, causing consumer libraries to mistake boundary-free fragments for complete JSON units. This resulted in malformed structured output, duplicated function/tool-call sentinels, and occasional token-order inversion when fragments were reordered by the proxy. This PR introduces a deterministic token-wrap reconciliation layer and a lightweight delimiter disambiguator to avoid mid-JSON collision while preserving low-latency streaming. Changes include: 1) a sequenced anchor inserted at chunk boundaries (non-user-visible, opt-in via runtime flag) to allow reassembly without altering event semantics, 2) a delimiter disambiguator that rewrites ambiguous trailing delimiter runs into an internal guarded form (transparent to OpenAI-compat consumers), 3) preservation ordering policy that tags function-call sentinel candidates with sequence stamps so interleaved fragments reserialize in canonical order, 4) additional unit and fuzz tests exercising reordered and split-UTF8 scenarios, and 5) a small runtime flag and migration note for Dedicated clusters to opt-in before rollout. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-1458) [x] unit tests added [x] integration test harness with proxy reorder simulation [x] benchmark smoke to verify <1ms median added latency under typical loads [x] compatibility shim preserves existing OpenAI-compat tokens. Impact/risk: low surface-area change to stream emitter; could affect custom proxy middleware that depends on exact byte-level framing. Rollout: staged feature-flagged rollout with Canary and Dedicated opt-in, automatic fallback to old path on runtime errors. Related: ENG-1458, PRs: #361112 (stream-test-harness), #364001 (sse-proxy-sim).
commits: Add token-wrap reconciler and delimiter disambiguator module
Add sequence-stamp propagation to stream emitter
Add unit tests for split-utf8 and fragment-reorder cases
Integration test harness: simulated proxy reorder scenarios
Feature flag and migration docs update for Dedicated rollout
Fix lint and CI failures reported by GH action and rerun checks
review_conversation: Reviewer Mateo: Found a race in the sequence-stamp propagation when a fragment is dropped by the proxy; suggested tagging with per-request monotonic counter instead of timestamp; Author Ava: switched to per-request monotonic stamp and added test simulating dropped fragments. Reviewer Priya: asked about Dedicated upgrade implications and KMS key handling for private clusters; Author: documented opt-in flag and fallback behavior, added migration note. Reviewer Samir: requested a small benchmark measurement for median p99 latency; Author: added bench-smoke job and confirmed <1ms median delta; approved after minor cleanup. CI initially failed on lint; fixed and reran; final CI green.
release_notes: Fixes cases where SSE chunk boundary collisions could produce malformed partial JSON or duplicate function-call sentinels by introducing token-wrap reconciliation and delimiter disambiguation. Opt-in rollout for Dedicated clusters; no API changes for hosted customers.
